variant.description: Visual style and semantic meaning of the toggletip. - normal (default): Standard informational toggletip. - raised: Elevated importance with dark header. - enhanced: Used for enhanced or primary information. -...

title.description: Title text displayed in the header.

description.description: Description text shown in the content area.

hasContent.description: Whether the toggletip draws the `content` text below the description.

hasActions.description: If true, shows the action buttons container. Both primary and secondary buttons are shown if labels are provided. TODO(designer): Should both buttons always be shown, or is one preferred as primary?

hasLeadingIcon.description: If true, shows the leading icon in the header. The icon adapts to the current variant by default, or can be overridden via the leading-icon slot. Available when title!=''.

hasTrailingIcon.description: If true, shows the trailing icon in the header. Use the trailing-icon slot to provide a custom icon. Available when title!=''.

customWidth.description: The width of the toggletip in px; unset sizes it to its content.

primaryButtonLabel.description: Label for the primary action button. Only shown if hasActions is true. Available when hasActions==true.

secondaryButtonLabel.description: Label for the secondary action button. Only shown if hasActions is true. Available when hasActions==true.

leadingIconName.description: The icon in the `leading-icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Main icon representing the message type or context (shown when hasLeadingIcon is true)

trailingIconName.description: The icon in the `trailing-icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Additional icon for secondary context or actions (shown when hasTrailingIcon is true)

content.description: The text in the `content` slot; empty puts none. Custom content area for rich or interactive elements (shown when hasContent is true)

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
